name: 李曉祺
objective:
本課程目標能培育具備跨域能力的智慧醫療人才，課程採理論與實作並重的教學模式，從醫學資料處理基礎出發，循序漸進引導學生掌握機器學習核心技術與深度學習方法。
課程內容涵蓋醫學影像處理、傳統機器學習、深度學習架構及相關進階主題，使學生建立完整的智慧醫療技術基礎。
培養目標包含掌握醫學資料處理與分析技術、具備機器學習與深度學習基礎能力、能夠完成智慧醫療相關專題研究、建立跨域合作與問題解決能力。
This course aims to cultivate interdisciplinary talent in smart healthcare. The
curriculum adopts a balanced approach between theory and practice, progressively guiding students from fundamental medical data processing to mastering core machine learning techniques and deep learning methods. Course content covers medical image processing, traditional machine learning,
deep learning architectures, and related advanced topics, establishing a comprehensive foundation in smart healthcare technologies. Through multiple
practical units and a capstone project, the course develops students technical expertise, independent research capabilities, and cross-disciplinary communication skills in the smart healthcare domain.
Learning objectives include mastering medical data processing and analysis
techniques, developing foundational proficiency in machine learning and deep
learning, completing practical projects in smart healthcare applications, and
building cross-disciplinary collaboration and problem-solving capabilities.
課程進度(1-16週):
Week 01 課程介紹與智慧醫療概論
Week 02 程式環境與醫療資料處理基礎（Python / MATLAB）
Week 03 醫學影像讀取與視覺化
Week 04 醫學影像前處理 Pipeline
Week 05 機器學習概論與特徵工程
Week 06 傳統機器學習分類實戰
Week 07 生理訊號分析與分類
Week 08 期中檢核與專題提案
Week 09 深度學習概論與遷移學習
Week 10 CNN 模型建構與訓練
Week 11 醫學影像分割實作
Week 12 Transformer 模型應用
Week 13 模型可解釋性分析
Week 14-16 期末專題實作輔導

materials: 提供參考數目與自行設計之教材
延伸教學與資源: ● 參與式創新教學 (Participatory & Innovative Teaching) 強調學生參與與產出，導入翻轉、PBL/專題、設計思考或遊戲化等策略。Emphasizes student engagement and outcomes by adopting strategies such as Flipped Classroom, PBL (Problem/Project- Based Learning), Design Thinking, or Gamification.● 數位科技融入 (Digital Technology Integration) 運用生成式 AI、VR/AR、IoT、IRS 等新興科技輔助教學與評量。Utilizes emerging technologies such as Generative AI, VR/AR, IoT, and IRS (Interactive Response Systems) to facilitate teaching and assessment.● 數位教材資源應用 (Application of Digital Resources) 採用影音多媒體或具開放授權之資源（如 OCW、開放教科書）作為主要或輔助教材。Adopts multimedia or open-licensed resources (e.g., OCW, Open Textbooks) as primary or supplementary teaching materials.
課程對應SDGs指標: SDG3：良好健康和福祉（Good Health and Well-being）SDG9：產業創新與基礎設施（Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure）
課程是否導入AI: ● 使用生成式 AI 作為教學過程的輔助工具（Use generative AI tools as an aid to the teaching process）● 鼓勵學生使用生成式 AI 工具（Encourage students to use generative AI tools）● 使用生成式 AI 進行課堂即時互動（Use generative AI for real-time classroom interaction）● 簡單介紹 AI 的基本概念（Briefly introduce the basic concept of AI）● 深入探討 AI 的原理與應用（Explore the principles and applications of AI in depth）
